attchmntText: Radha Madhav Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Radha Madhav Corporation Limited submitted the newspaper publication of unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in Business Standard and Damanganga Times. The submission was made by Nitin Jain, Whole Time Director and CFO, with DIN 09833381.

attchmntText: Radha Madhav Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
